articles.summary: A practical guide to where RWE fits across discovery, trial design, study execution, regulatory strategy, launch, market access, and life-cycle management - and what can still go wrong.
articles.title: Real-World Evidence in Drug Development: Opportunities and Challenges

articles.summary: RWE timelines are not driven by the final statistical model. The delay comes from protocol specificity, data access, fit-for-purpose checks, cohort logic, and evidence packaging.
articles.title: Why RWE Studies Still Take Months: Where the Time Goes

articles.summary: FDA leaders are signaling that one strong pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence should become the default approval path. That makes real-world evidence an earlier, more strategic part of development.
articles.title: FDA's Single-Pivotal-Trial Shift: What It Means for RWE Teams
